versions.content: Continue in next periodic rate scheduler if more PDIDs than available connections If a scheduler type 2 PDID transmission is active according to [SWS_Dcm_01572] and the number of scheduled PDIDs is larger than the number of available periodic connections, the Dcm shall continue to send the next scheduled PDIDs the next time the periodic transmission rate scheduler elapses.
